skill_card.name: Requirement Analysis Skill
skill_card.description: A polyglot, deterministic pre-development planning skill that analyzes natural language requirements against a codebase to identify candidate files to touch, exact code insertion points, design patterns to follow, and applicable security, compliance, and formatting rules.

tasks.name: Parse and structure natural language requirement
tasks.description: Extracts semantic intent, target technical entities, action types, and domain security tags from raw user feature descriptions or Jira tickets.
tasks.input_schema: Natural language requirement prompt or user story.
tasks.output_schema: Structured intent metadata, entity tags, and domain classifications.

tasks.name: Identify candidate files and insertion points
tasks.description: Scans the codebase index to rank existing files to modify or suggest new file paths, locating exact line numbers and symbol references.
tasks.output_schema: Ranked file modification candidates with line locations and match reasons.

tasks.name: Generate architecture plan and compliance checklist
tasks.description: Identifies existing structural patterns to follow and emits a tailored security, regulatory compliance, and linting checklist.
tasks.output_schema: Complete pre-development implementation plan and compliance checklist.
